primary_endpoint: common-hidden-trace SNR; paired at clean-template level for synthetic data; descriptive within each field survey

synthetic.recovery: frozen legacy nested zero/linear/warm40/cold40; observed-only gain and candidate selection
synthetic.scope: Twenty separately seeded synthetic structural realizations across five families; not twenty real surveys. New prospective experiment after inspecting the historical six-template study.

external.selection_rule: Sort inline identifiers from trace headers; take floor((n-1)*q) for q=0.25,0.5,0.75; centered 120 consecutive crossline ranks per section. Select the same center sample window [512,768). No score-based replacement or silent skipping of invalid sections.
external.recovery: unchanged eight-candidate pool from Viking/F3; no new-survey retuning
external.geometry: trace ranks with 25 nominal units per trace; report gaps in trace intervals, not physical meters
external.scope: Two additional field surveys first accessed by this project after protocol freezing; dependent sections/seeds do not increase survey count. Poststack interpolation does not establish acquisition cost savings or imaging improvement.

spatial_waveform.selection_rule: Centered consecutive 16 inline ranks and 16 crossline ranks, samples [512,640), fixed before amplitude access.
spatial_waveform.recovery: fixed 3D Fourier FISTA, 80 iterations, lambda fraction 0.01 of observed-only FFT peak; measured columns projected back
spatial_waveform.scope: Same-volume 2D spatial mask and waveform interpolation validation. Grid-rank geometry only; no migration or physical acquisition-cost claim.
